description: This file defines the JobSpecificationAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It serves as an API endpoint for fetching job specification details related to a specific job title (via the getOne method). The class extends a generic Endpoint and implements ResourceEndpoint, providing RESTful access to job specification data, and includes validation rules for request parameters.

classes.name: JobSpecificationAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for accessing job specifications related to specific job titles. It provides methods to retrieve a single job specification by job title ID, with validation rules for the request.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of JobTitleService used to fetch job title related data.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a job specification based on the provided job title ID. Returns a resource result encapsulating the fetched data or throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring that the job title ID parameter is a positive integer.

methods.description: Method to handle update operations, currently not implemented, throws exception.

methods.description: Validation rule method for update, not implemented.
